findings.defect: This removes the speaker’s minimizing and qualified phrasing: 그냥, 일종의 (“just, a kind of”). The accepted baseline also preserved “just.”
findings.rationale: The source describes the dream as merely a kind of memory, rather than stating without qualification that it was a memory.
findings.replacement: It was just a kind of memory.

summary: The chapter is largely faithful, but it omits a distinct point about mental enlightenment and slightly overstates a tentative description of the dream.
